Perfect to toss in my purse to reapply if needed. As a person of color I love how seamless it is to blend and not leave that awful white cast on my face like other sunscreens. I also love the fact that it doesn't leave me looking greasy or oily. It's light and weightless and bonus points is that it also acts as a primer. So far it's been overall great, I've used it a couple of times in my makeup routine as a primer and it's held up pretty well for what it's worth. This is a great luxe sunscreen.

I have used so so many different facial SPF over the years and could never find the perfect one until now. All products I tried before were too heavy to be worn comfortably under makeup, left a shiny or white sheen, and often irritated my sensitive skin. The Urban Environment Mineral Clear Sunscreen is THE perfect one, and I hope Shiseido NEVER stops making it. This product feels so weightless and absolutely beautiful, and feels like you are wearing nothing. It is not greasy, does not leave an oily or white sheen, and layers seamlessly with your make up because it goes on so smoothly. I have very sensitive skin and this product so far has not cause any irritation or redness. This is truly a wonderful product and worth purchasing.

avis.titre: Good product, bad packaging, so-so value
avis.texte: The product is great. However, I am disappointed in the packaging. It was 2/3 to 3/4 full leaving a large space empty. It's deceptive and wastes packaging material. For one bottle it may not be much but for tens of thousands of sales, it adds up. I'm surprised because Shiseido will refill many of their jars and bottles if you take them in to a retailer. I had the impression that Shiseido was moving towards being more green and this has made me question that supposition.
I've been using this for the past couple weeks and it provides great coverage! It doesn't leave a white caste either which is a problem I have with different brands of sunscreen.
Use everyday! Love everything about this product! Goes on super easy!

This sunscreen is perfect and does not leave any white cast, blends in fast, makes your skin glowy but not sticky or oily looking. It also doesnt have any hidden chemical filters which is difficult to find. I just wish it was a little bit cheaper or came in a bigger bottle. I use this only on my face and the Shiseido Mineral SPF 60 on my body. Both are great products!

avis.titre: I love this product and will most likely buy it once I run o
avis.texte: Honestly, I love this sunscreen. Having dry skin and living at the beach makes it difficult to find a long lasting and moisturizing sunscreen. This is lightweight, nourishing, and protects flawlessly!

avis.titre: This brown skin girl loves this sunscreen
avis.texte: Goes in smooth and mixes well with my moisturizer. Yes it has a white cast however the cast disappears after you take the time to rub the sunscreen in. I am a woman with brown skin and this sunscreen works better than anything else I use.

I've been using this gem for a little over a week in this hot NY weather. It feels like nothing and yet it protects the skin and keeps you moisturized. I barely smell any type of odor. I have a medium skin tone and this blends like a dream (just remember to shake well). I like the SPF 50 and that it's mineral. I wish is came in a larger size because I'd stock up for sure. Works nice under my BB cream and I don't look like an oil slick. Please do not ever discontinue this amazing product!
I really like this sunscreen - it's lightweight and my liquid foundation goes on nice over it, no pilling. I have sensitive skin and it hasn't irritated it.
